item.title: Why is SendGrid emailing me about supporting ICE?
item.description:
📝 This is a compromised SendGrid customer account being used to send phishing emails to American targets about American political issues. coNone of these are sendgrid. When these emails hit your inbox, they pass authentication because they really were sent through SendGrid, just not by SendGrid.
🔗 Read more: https://fredbenenson.com/blog/2026/01/09/why-is-sendgrid-emailing-me-about-supporting-ice/

item.title: Cloudspecs: Cloud Hardware Evolution Through the Looking Glass
item.description:
📝 Most surprisingly, NVMe storage performance in the cloud has stagnated since 2016. On-prem hardware comparison shows that this stagnation is not cloud price gouging. This paper validates that sentiment.
🔗 Read more: http://muratbuffalo.blogspot.com/2026/01/cloudspecs-cloud-hardware-evolution.html
